purpose: Frozen stance/laboratory context: leg-plane geometry, force-plate chain and reporting conventions.

decisions.sensitivity: plane-separation sensitivity only as engineering geometry (+/- 0.010 m)
decisions.notes: 0.170 m is NOT an elite-soccer CMJ stance-width claim; true stance width and lateral balance are outside V1.

decisions.statement: Foot orientation in the reduced model.
decisions.value: feet parallel (yaw removed); no toe-out angle is modeled
decisions.notes: Do not run a biological stance-width sensitivity by sliding feet laterally without a coherent 3-D pelvis/hip model.

decisions.value: indoor force-plate setting with training shoes; not cleat-on-turf
decisions.notes: Field/turf/cleat validity is outside the claim.

value.rule: >=1000 Hz canonical comparison export with documented anti-aliasing/filter path; raw native signals retained

decisions.locator: force-platform sampling literature recorded in the system authority
decisions.notes: Native simulator state/contact resolution remains event authority.

decisions.statement: Countermovement depth and stance are self-selected.
decisions.value: no single ideal knee/hip depth is frozen; professional protocols commonly yield ~60-90 deg knee flexion while elite data show legitimate strategy variability
decisions.notes: Microscopic/noise-only dips must be rejected, but no elite squat depth may be hard-coded as optimal.

decisions.value: all performance and force metrics are reported relative to the quiet-standing reference, with raw and filtered traces retained
